candidates.description: This feature vector represents German verb prefixes and past participle morphemes, specifically starting with "ge-".
These tokens represent German auxiliary and modal verbs inflected for various tenses, persons, and moods.
This feature vector represents German prepositions indicating spatial, temporal, or directional relations.
These tokens function as German subordinating conjunctions and relative pronouns that introduce dependent clauses.
German possessive and demonstrative pronouns or determiners.
This vector represents negation, absence, and exclusionary terms across multiple languages.
These tokens are common German grammatical words, such as conjunctions, pronouns, and auxiliary verbs.
These tokens represent first, second, and third-person personal pronouns in various grammatical cases across English and German.
This feature vector represents common German adverbs and modifiers used to express degree, frequency, or continuation.
This vector activates for first- and third-person personal pronouns across multiple languages.
